wiki.title: Counselor Edmond
wiki.text:
Counselor Edmond is a pixie NPC that can be found in the perimeters of Camp Chatty, located in the Greenwood Forest.

He is also an enemy NPC in Bigfoot Defender. He is with Jake, Tyra, and Kaela to find and hurt Bigfoot.

Quest:Camp Troubles
Quest:Confronting Bigfoot
Quest:Putting Your Foot Down (repeatable)
